about: Every item the PC jobs could not verify without the A100 (their Server-unverified lists). tier: auto = a probe in scripts/server_checks.py; smoke = E00's one-question runs; measure = inside the owning E-job's measurement.

checks.expect: VLLMGenerator.generate([prompt]) returns a list whose [0] is non-empty text
PromptTemplate.get_string(messages=[...]) renders the Llama-3.1 chat template: system header, messages in order, ending with the assistant generation header (also for system-only prompts)
DenseRetriever results render as 'Doc 1(Title: ...)' lines in the query pool, as in the baseline's saved prompts
Item.update_output accepts every key written; intermediate_data.json has the recorded run's keys
run_variant --backend flashrag --dataset NQ --limit 1 --profile writes all five files, nonzero elapsed_ms, Llama token counts, summary.json with em/f1/acc/precision/recall
Naive prompts from standard_rag_prompt_template equal the stored baseline Naive prompts for the same question
retriever.batch_search([q])[0] passage ids equal the stored Naive retrieval (results/retrieval-200.jsonl)
Evaluator(config).evaluate on stored preds returns the recorded metrics
--resume after kill -9 mid-question gives final logs identical to an uninterrupted run
FlashRAG's save_dir/<arm>/<timestamp> inside the run directory does not disturb --resume
configs/cached.json, NQ --limit 3 --interleave: cache lines <= questions x unique queries, identical ids/scores across arms, index '<path>:<size>:<mtime_ns>'
DenseRetriever.batch_search(qs, return_score=True) returns (rows, score_rows) in request order with descending float scores
index_identity on the 64.5 GB index takes well under a second
batch_agents_in_round on/off: per-question output-hash mismatches within the A/A floor
VLLMGenerator preserves prompt order in a batch (each output answers its own prompt)
Latency and calls per question for moderator_final_only and batching, including StrategyQA (paper: 2R+1 answer calls)
zero_novelty_exit: query rounds and retriever calls vs baseline on real E5 results
skip_duplicate_query: a small number of skipped searches and no pool change
vLLM raw output for a 4-token cap reports finish_reason 'length'
Llama-3.1 token counts and the EM/F1 effect of R=1, token caps and concise agents, 2Wiki included
conda-forge faiss 1.8.0 CUDA build imports and faiss.get_num_gpus() == 1
index_cpu_to_all_gpus(useFloat16=True) uses about 32.25 GiB and fits beside vLLM at gpu_memory_utilization 0.45
Retriever-before-generator order prevents the vLLM pool OOM with faiss_gpu
OMP_NUM_THREADS/MKL_NUM_THREADS equal the flag and FAISS reports the same thread count
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.total parses as one card of about 80 GiB
End-to-end FlashRAG run with configs/arms/E01/D.json
Llama-3.1 still cites the evidence and emits the answer marker with <document> blocks and the data notice
Prompt-token growth and latency from keeping superseded passages
Rewrite audit rates on real rewrites reported as rates, not ground truth
QueryStage_QueryPool serialises the EvidencePool as a plain {query: [docs]} mapping
context_token_budget 2500: measured prompt tokens stay under budget and the marker parses
enable_prefix_caching: quality within the A/A floor, lower prefill/TTFT
The evidence-first system prefix renders through the real PromptTemplate (inspect one prompt)
ScoredGenerator returns finite Proponent/Opponent log-probs for Judge prompts (first tokens distinct, in the top-k)
Label coverage is high enough that judge_fallback is rare; tune k otherwise
resolve_max_tokens honours the scorer's max_tokens; scored calls report 'scored'
One configs/arms/E02b/D.json question records score and fallback counts
opponent_action_schema: invalid-action rate with the real chat template
judge_sees_refined_query: the Judge's Question line names the latest refined query and nothing else changes
Anchored passages survive and the named non-original query is superseded under a real retriever
The sufficiency scorer returns finite sufficient/insufficient log-probs on real vLLM
fit_gate.py on E05 transcripts clears the AUROC bar; scored-call latency recorded
Grouped requests across questions come back in order from real vLLM
batch_search with 20-64 gathered queries makes one encoder forward and one FAISS search
The refill window raises stage occupancy and questions/hour on real vLLM
FAISS behaviour above 4096 query rows (the default cap is 64; record only if exceeded)
Bm25Retriever on the E04 index returns 20 {id, contents} dicts with float scores, no progress bar, near 0.5 GB RSS per 2M passages
Query tokenisation matches the corpus build; a hand-picked query retrieves its passage
CrossEncoderReranker gives one score per pair; latency of rerank_k=20 on 500-token passages
Hybrid behind FlashRAG completes one question with both score floors and rerank_k set
A real MiniCheck model scores one (passage, answer) pair with a probability in [0, 1]
MiniCheck weight licences confirmed on Hugging Face (model cards needed login)

B2 on the real index: raw search(q) and batch_search([q])[0] agree on a short query; the report records whether a >64-character query diverges (B2 predicts it does; DRAG takes that raw path only when neither search_via_batch nor retrieval_cache is set, i.e. E01's arms)
ScoredGenerator.last_finish_reasons is 'scored' per prompt; the text path reports none
lazy_query_opponent with the generative Judge on FlashRAG logs Sufficiency scores, never 'unavailable'
